lessons_used: For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
The choose_path reorder change was helpful, winning Round 4 (+11.9% after noise correction).
The home redesign change was helpful, winning Round 6 (+3.6% after noise correction).
The sign_in reorder change was harmful (-6.1% after noise correction) and was stopped early.
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_flow and redesign), choose_path, sign_in, and home redesign changes, as only one test of each kind has been completed.
Predictions were too high for tests with no clear effect or negative results, but underpredicted the major winning test in Round 4.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a split layout, placing real-time pet visual preview cards alongside the name and certificate input form.
candidates.why: Adoption stage drops to 60.9% conversion with a long median duration of 89s; showing live visual response reduces hesitation while filling out details.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Home Intro Control Primer Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the home intro welcome screen into a multi-step interactive flow demonstrating how to hide, drag, and talk to the pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report user confusion after onboarding on how to control or hide their pet, and finish step drops to 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Try dragging your pet, double-clicking to open settings, or toggling taskbar visibility.

components.text: Tip: Right click your pet anytime to hide or mute desktop sounds.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro within onboarding without breaking base rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high finish drop-off with support ticket backing, but new_flow/new_screen changes historically showed no clear lift and require heavy build effort.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Progress Time Estimate
candidates.change: Adds estimated completion time and clear progress status indicator on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing users to abandon the app believing it froze.

waiting.hint: Generation usually takes under 2 minutes. We will notify you when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds completion time estimate to waiting screen during a real wait.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses severe home waiting time (2336s mean) with low-overhead progress indicators to reduce drop-off.

candidates.title: Choose Path Starter Bonus Visuals
candidates.change: Adds accessory preview badges to each path option card on the choose path screen.
candidates.why: Choose path has a very long mean time of 514s, indicating decision paralysis when choosing an initial onboarding path.

guard.reason: 'choose_path.replace.path_options[1]': a badge cannot do the path_options job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Persistence Layout
candidates.change: Replaces standard sign-in options with a card layout that explicitly highlights cloud save and cross-device pet recovery.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery messaging critical.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to the Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in so your pet's personality, accessories, and memory are never lost if you re-install.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Pet Selection Dynamic Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated preview screen between picking a friend and certificate completion to display animated pet behaviors.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion (60.9%) and support received reports of custom pets failing or looking unexpected.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_preview']

candidates.title: Background Pet Generation Notification
candidates.change: Adds a desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is over 38 minutes (2336s), showing users leave the screen open or idle while waiting.

waiting.body: Your pet is being brought to life. You can safely minimize this window; we'll alert you when it's ready.

guard.reason: Adds notification toggle to waiting screen as permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at extreme home step delays by letting users minimize, supported by duration metrics.

candidates.title: Story Screen Archetype Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the initial story intro screen into a spotlight layout showcasing pet traits and interactive preview clips.
candidates.why: Round 4 showed that structural improvements early in the choose_path stage gave a +11.9% overall conversion gain.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Banner Prompt
candidates.change: Adds a prominent highlight banner on the home welcome screen showing direct key bindings and taskbar control tips.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported users not knowing how to talk to or hide their pet after completing setup.

components.text: Quick Command: Press Shift+Pet to open interaction menu

guard.reason: Adds direct shortcut tip banner to home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Clear evidence from tickets and finish funnel drop-off; low cost UI banner prompt on existing screen.

candidates.title: Sign-In Progress Preservation Messaging
candidates.change: Updates headline, body, and hint copy on sign_in screen to reassure users that signing in preserves their current pet progress.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops conversion to 72.9%, and users express fear of lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Sign in to secure your chosen pet, custom settings, and earned items to your account.
sign_in.hint: Your current pet choices will be attached to your account instantly.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy within onboarding without violating base rules.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step (27.1% loss) backed by user feedback; simple copy change is cheap (cost 2) and directly resolves progress loss anxiety.

lessons_next: For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
The choose_path reorder change won Round 4 (+12.0% after noise correction), but evidence is still thin (1 test).
The home redesign change won Round 6 (+3.6% after noise correction), but evidence is still thin (1 test).
The sign_in reorder change was harmful (-6.2% after noise correction) and was stopped early, though evidence is still thin (1 test).
Evidence is still thin for adoption, finish, choose_path, home redesign, and sign_in changes as only one test of each kind has been run.
Predictions were too high for tests with negative results or no clear effect, but underpredicted the major winning test in Round 4.
